sentences.text: Hmph. I reviewed the data, and based on the sensor events, I highly doubt there was any spectral activity last night.
Between 05:30 and 06:00, the house registered a massive spike in appliance energy, observing 360 Wh when only 50 Wh was expected.
This significant energy usage, which is far above the expected range, probably indicates that someone was using several machines, maybe a kettle or a coffee maker.
The data points to a mundane mechanical event, not any supernatural occurrences in the house.
